sloka: विनीतैर् अन्त पालैः च रक्षोभिः च सुरक्षितम् ।मुख्याभिः च वर स्त्रीभिः परिपूर्णम् समन्ततः ॥५-६-९॥
transliteration: vinītair anta pālaiḥ ca rakṣobhiḥ ca surakṣitam ।mukhyābhiḥ ca vara strībhiḥ paripūrṇam samantataḥ ॥5-6-9॥

translations.english: The place was full of beautful women, carefully protected by disciplined guards as well as demons.
